cases.name: Marbella Martinez
cases.about: She was a corrections officer with the Salt Lake County Sheriff’s Office in Salt Lake City, UT.
cases.narrative: On 8/1/2024, her body was found in her bedroom (at her father's house) after police were called to do a welfare check.
